Research notes (today is Monday, Oct 12, 2026; I assumed the NBA's Toronto Raptors, since the question doesn't say which team):

- No Raptors game tonight, Monday Oct 12. Every schedule I found has the team's last game on Saturday, Oct 10 and its next game on Tuesday, Oct 13. Those were ESPN, Sync2Cal, Sports Media Watch and Wikipedia.
- The Raptors beat the Clippers on Oct 10 in Vancouver. ESPN lists the score as 114–106.
- The next game is a preseason game against the New York Knicks on Tuesday, Oct 13. It is at Scotiabank Arena in Toronto, with tip-off at 7:00 PM ET. ESPN, Sync2Cal and Fubo all list that time.
- Canadian TV is listed as TSN or Sportsnet, and the Knicks' broadcast is MSG Sportsnet. Sources differ on which channel carries it: Yahoo's schedule shows "SN" (Sportsnet), Fubo lists MSG Sportsnet, and Fox Sports lists MSG 2.
- TSN reported on Oct 12 that Kawhi Leonard will be available to make his preseason debut for Toronto in the Knicks game, per coach Darko Rajakovic.
- After that, the Raptors play at the Knicks on Thursday, Oct 15 (7:30 PM ET) and at Detroit on Friday, Oct 16. The regular season starts Oct 20 for the league, per Yahoo Sports. One schedule site lists Toronto's home opener as Oct 21 against Chicago.
